a: Reggie James is a UK-based business adviser and operator with 25 years in technology markets. He founded Digital Clarity, built DC Storm through to its acquisition by Rakuten, led commercial operations for an internet business listed in Singapore, and has been COO and Executive Director of DBMM Group Inc. (OTC: DBMM), a US public company, since 2011. He is based in Guildford, Surrey, and London.

He advises CEOs, founders, boards and investors on the decisions that shape a business: growth, investment, proposition, commercial structure, market entry and changes of direction. He works as a personal adviser, through fixed-fee growth and performance reviews, alongside investors, and in fractional executive roles where hands-on involvement helps.

q: How can I work with Reggie James?
a: There are four ways: as the CEO's Commercial Adviser on a monthly basis; through a fixed-fee Growth and Performance Review; as the Investor's Commercial Partner on a deal or across a portfolio; or on The Next Chapter, a strategic project for a business changing direction. Use the contact form on this site or message him on LinkedIn.

q: How is working with Reggie James different from hiring Digital Clarity?
a: Leaders work with Reggie personally for judgement, direction and experience at CEO, board and investor level. Digital Clarity is the specialist firm that diagnoses and delivers commercial growth programmes with a team. The two are designed to work together.

DC Storm was a marketing measurement platform that Reggie James built within Digital Clarity to measure performance across fragmented digital channels. Around 48% of major media planning and buying agencies used it before it was acquired by Rakuten.

q: What is Reggie James's role at DBMM Group?
a: Since 2011 he has been COO, Senior Vice President and Executive Director of Digital Brand Media & Marketing Group, Inc., a US public company quoted as OTC: DBMM. Digital Clarity is its wholly owned operating business.

q: Does Reggie James have a podcast?
a: Yes. Reggie James - Perspectives has more than 50 episodes of conversations on B2B growth, go-to-market and leadership, available on Spotify, Apple Podcasts and at reggiejamespodcast.com.
